evidence.detail: The class is constructed only by R85 DepthBufferedImageSurface and holds only the synthetic parent-surface reference.
DepthBufferedImageSurface schedules the task exactly once through SwingUtilities.invokeLater from its live draw path after the first framebuffer blit, guarded by a static one-shot flag.

run() obtains the active Launcher JFrame, selects either 1134x537 or 1312x800 from the client layout-mode flag, centers the frame on Toolkit screen dimensions, makes it visible when appropriate, and maximizes it when the larger layout exceeds available screen width.
The task owns no rendering pixels, packet state or gameplay logic; its only effect is deferred top-level client-window sizing/positioning after surface initialization.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the one-shot Swing EDT task that sizes, centers and conditionally maximizes the client Launcher window after the first DepthBufferedImageSurface draw.
